items.observation: The state machine that scans strings and escapes is written twice, inside `_completeJson` and `_openClosers`. The second rescans the buffer from the start.
items.proposed_fix: A single private scanner that returns the open-container stack. Safety net: the prefix property test at partial_json_test.dart:6.
items.closure_criteria: A single private scanner returns the open-container stack and both _completeJson and _openClosers use it. The prefix property test in partial__test.dart passes.

items.kind: needless work on the hot path
items.observation: On the path called for every delta, the RegExps are rebuilt on each call.
items.closure_criteria: The RegExps are top-level final constants and none is built inside the per-delta path.

items.observation: The dartdoc says 'generated builders are planned for a later release'. The same promise also appears in README.md:251-252 and CHANGELOG.md:363, with no tracked issue.
items.proposed_fix: The dartdoc should describe only current behavior. Keep the plan in the README or in an issue.
items.closure_criteria: The streaming.dart dartdoc describes only current behavior and the builders plan lives in the README or a tracked issue.

items.observation: Provider-specific extractors and provider-independent stream combinators live in the same 401-line file. A new provider changes the file of the general pipeline. streamPartialFrom and streamPartial repeat the same 'build if Map' loop.
items.proposed_fix: Move the extractors to a separate lib/src file (the export stays the same). The From variant should delegate to a shared private helper.
items.closure_criteria: Provider extractors live in a separate lib/src file and the show list in lib/stream_struct.dart is unchanged. streamPartialFrom delegates to one shared helper and the public signatures keep the Map<String, dynamic> event type.
